title: A crowded category with no gel rival
lede: No source we opened names a competing drink with gel spheres. The record names the maker’s competitors in the new age beverage market and describes the market they shared.[^6]

blocks.title: The market around Orbitz

items.text: US new age beverage market in wholesale dollars, 1992 to an estimated 2002, per Beverage Marketing Corporation as quoted in Clearly Canadian’s annual report for 2002[^6]

blocks.source: Clearly Canadian annual report for 2002.[^6] The figures are for the market, not for any company in it.

blocks.title: Hansen Natural
blocks.body:
Clearly Canadian’s annual report for 2002 names Hansen Natural Corp., producer of various natural sodas, smoothies, functional drinks, juices and iced teas, in its Competition section.[^6] Hansen’s own annual report for 2002 shows net sales that rose in every year from 1998 to 2002, the years in which Clearly Canadian’s total revenues fell.[^20][^6]

The comparison is loose. Hansen reports net sales and Clearly Canadian reports total revenues, and neither measures market share or competition for gel drinks.

blocks.who: Al Ries, marketing analyst, quoted by AP, October 1996[^1]
